relations soured: Relations soured between the two neighbors after they argued loudly about the noisy dog.
兩戶鄰居為了那隻吵鬧的狗大吵一架之後，關係惡化了。
the deal turned sour: At first both companies were happy, but the deal turned sour when one side refused to pay.
一開始兩家公司都很滿意，但當其中一方拒絕付款時，交易告吹了。
sour the mood: His rude jokes soured the mood at the party, and many guests went home early.
他無禮的笑話破壞了派對的氣氛，許多客人提早回家了。
milk turns sour: If you leave it out of the fridge on a hot day, milk turns sour very quickly.
如果在大熱天把牛奶放在冰箱外，牛奶會很快變酸。
sour grapes: When he said the prize wasn't important after he lost, everyone knew it was just sour grapes.
他輸了之後說那個獎不重要，大家都知道那只是酸葡萄心理。
sow the seeds of doubt: The strange phone call began to sow the seeds of doubt in her mind about her new boyfriend.
那通奇怪的電話開始在她心中對新男友播下懷疑的種子。
sow discord: Someone was spreading false rumors online to sow discord among the members of the club.
有人在網路上散播假謠言，在社團成員之間挑撥離間。
sow confusion: Changing the exam schedule at the last minute will only sow confusion among students and their parents.
在最後一刻更改考試時間表只會在學生和家長之間製造混亂。
sow wheat: In autumn, the farmers sow wheat in their fields and harvest it early the next summer.
秋天時，農夫們在田裡播種小麥，隔年初夏收成。
space out the chairs: Please space out the chairs in the hall so that each student has enough room during the exam.
請把禮堂裡的椅子隔開放，讓每位學生考試時都有足夠的空間。
space out: I was so tired in class that I began to space out and didn't hear the teacher's question.
我上課時太累了，開始恍神，沒聽到老師的問題。
evenly spaced: The trees along the road are evenly spaced, about ten meters apart from each other.
路邊的樹間隔均勻，彼此相距大約十公尺。
space out payments: The store lets customers space out payments for the new laptop over twelve months.
這家店讓顧客把新筆電分十二個月分期付款。
spare no effort: After the accident, the hospital promised to spare no effort to save the injured driver's life.
事故發生後，醫院承諾會不遺餘力搶救受傷駕駛的性命。
spare someone's feelings: I didn't tell her that her cake tasted bad because I wanted to spare her feelings.
我沒告訴她她的蛋糕很難吃，因為我想顧及她的感受。
spare a thought for: While you enjoy your holiday dinner, spare a thought for those who have no home this winter.
當你享用節日晚餐時，為那些今年冬天無家可歸的人想一想。
spare the details: Just tell me what happened and spare the details; we don't have much time.
只要告訴我發生了什麼事，省略細節；我們沒有太多時間。
spare someone's life: The king decided to spare the prisoner's life because the young man had once saved his daughter.
國王決定饒那名囚犯一命，因為那個年輕人曾經救過他的女兒。
time to spare: We left early and arrived at the station with plenty of time to spare before the train came.
我們提早出門，抵達車站時離火車進站還有很多多餘時間。
spare the rod: My grandfather believes that if you spare the rod, you will spoil the child.
我爺爺相信，如果省了棍子不打，就會寵壞孩子。
spark a debate: The new rule about cellphones in class is likely to spark a debate among teachers, students, and parents.
關於上課使用手機的新規定很可能在老師、學生和家長之間引發辯論。
spark interest: The museum's fun hands-on experiments often spark interest in science among young children who visit.
博物館有趣的動手實驗常常激起來參觀的小朋友對科學的興趣。
spark protests: The government's plan to raise gas prices may spark protests in several cities next weekend.
政府調漲油價的計畫下週末可能在好幾個城市引爆抗議。
spark controversy: Comments about war or politics can easily spark controversy online, so the singer usually avoids them.
關於戰爭或政治的評論很容易在網路上引發爭議，所以那位歌手通常避而不談。
spark one's imagination: Reading fantasy novels can spark your imagination and help you write more creative stories.
閱讀奇幻小說可以激發你的想像，幫助你寫出更有創意的故事。
spark off a crisis: A sudden drop in the stock market could spark off a crisis that affects banks around the world.
股市突然下跌可能觸發一場影響全球銀行的危機。
spark a dream: Watching astronauts on TV can spark a dream in young children to fly into space one day.
在電視上看到太空人，可以點燃小朋友有一天要飛上太空的夢想。
eyes sparkle: Whenever she talks about her new puppy, her eyes sparkle with joy and she can't stop smiling.
每當她談起她的新小狗，她的眼睛就因喜悅而發亮，笑個不停。
sparkle with wit: Her speech at the graduation sparkled with wit, and the audience laughed and clapped many times.
她在畢業典禮上的演講妙語如珠，觀眾笑了好幾次，也鼓掌了好幾次。
sparkling conversation: The dinner was wonderful, full of good food and sparkling conversation that lasted until midnight.
那頓晚餐很棒，有美食和一直持續到半夜的精彩的對話。
sparkle on stage: The shy girl seems quiet in class, but she really sparkles on stage when she sings.
那個害羞的女孩在課堂上看似安靜，但她唱歌時真的在台上光芒四射。
